card.name: Lerato
card.situation: Operations coordinator at a logistics company in Pretoria. Has been there five years.
card.day_to_day: Schedules deliveries, sorts out problems with drivers and warehouses, and keeps the weekly delivery reports up to date in spreadsheets.
card.strongest_skill: Organising operations and solving problems under pressure.
card.skill_example: During a fuel strike, re-planned a week of deliveries so that every hospital client still got their stock on time.
card.wants_next: To move into tech. Has no coding experience at all and says so plainly when talking about what she wants next, but is curious about tech companies.
card.work_arrangement: Prefers hybrid but is open to the office.
card.notice_period: When asked, says one month. Then, at the very start of her next answer, whatever the question, corrects it: she just checked and it is actually two months.
card.salary_stance: Happy to share: about R32,000 a month.
card.behaviour: Changes her answer on notice period: first says one month, then opens her very next answer by correcting it to two months. Always make this correction.

summary.fact: Operations coordinator wanting to move into tech

current_role.fact: Operations coordinator at a logistics company

skills.fact: Organising operations and problem-solving, with the fuel-strike re-plan as the example

notice_period.fact: Two months (her final answer after first saying one month)
